note: Four colours, each the ground of some cells and the ink of others, so the palette has to survive every ordered pair rather than each colour on the paper. Measured by `tools/palette.js` for perceptual distance under normal and colour-deficient vision, and by `tools/contrast.js` for WCAG contrast. The closest pair is green against blue, which a tritanope can barely separate; the keyline is what carries the six pairs that sit under the 3:1 floor.
